scope: Current user-selected original floor plus preserved historical measurements for rejected painted floor variants.

currentSelection.userSelection: L’ancienne dalle du jeu, avant le passage au style peint
currentSelection.resolverContract: For each production filename, the optional external alias or same-name file is tried only if that file exists. With no floor alias and no same-name root candidate, the installed production path is selected. Subdirectories are not searched.
currentSelection.resolutionVerificationMethod: Read-only inspection of exact resolver source and filesystem existence; no runtime launch or resolver test rerun.
currentSelection.nativeQaScope: Upcoming room captures validate the return to the ten installed original floor variants. No further adoption QA of the rejected V4 floor candidates.
limitations: This verifies selection and exact installed/source bytes, not a fresh native screenshot.
Water runtime changes are independent and outside this material-selection audit.

historicalStudy.scope: Historical measurements of the rejected six-candidate V4 floor study before its aliases were removed. Paths now point to archived source artifacts; former resolution facts remain explicitly historical.
historicalStudy.passedMeaning: Historical file integrity at measurement time only. Rejected candidate art is not accepted; consult currentSelection for today’s active configuration.

aliasManifest.note: The original22-alias mapping is preserved by historicalStudy.aliases below; this path now contains the current12-alias selection.

method.colour: PNG encoded RGB values0..255. Luma proxy0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B, without sRGB linearization; this is not physical light intensity.
method.centralFace: Each image centre20%..80% in X/Y, integer lower bounds and exclusive upper bounds. This isolates the main plate field from joints and corner fasteners. Exact rectangles are recorded.
method.variability: Population standard deviation and5th/95th percentile within each region; between-tile comparisons use region means.
method.reading: Pillow decode toRGBA and NumPy read-only measurements. No resampling or image writes.
method.sha: SHA256 of original file bytes. All eight preserved images are also compared directly byte for byte.
method.runtimeContract: Four standard slots chosen by stable cell hash,94% prior to fracture overrides; six aged slots use the same hash at6%. V4 maps aged slots alternately to two physical images. Texture loading caches paths but preserves all selection slots.

observations: All six palettes retain blue-grey ordering B>G>R; there is no abrupt warm/cool hue switch.
StandardD is the brightest candidate, about8% above the mean central face ofA/B/C. A andC are closely matched, B is slightly darker.

Standard whole-image luma spans40.89..44.46; central-face luma spans40.37..44.17. This can create mild bright accents in the hash distribution, so inspect the actual room before deciding it needs correction.
The two aged candidates are darker than the standard-group average and close to the V3 reference. Their6% selection rate makes them sparse accents.
The V4 standard-group average is brighter than V3. This is a material-palette difference and is not evidence of a change in scene lighting.
No fixed alternation/checkerboard is imposed by these aliases. Any visible pattern depends on the cell hash arrangement, authored brush motifs, joints and final game scale.
limits: Mean-colour similarity cannot prove absence of repetition or patterned brush silhouettes.
No perceptual pass/fail threshold is claimed; the8% observation is descriptive, not a calibrated visibility threshold.
Joint alignment, baked highlight consistency and readability at48px must be checked in the native room capture.
This report predates native V4/water QA and does not assess the animated water code.
